definition: Extent of the segmented cell along the LOCAL bone long axis, in micrometres.
computation: Projection of the cell's voxel coordinates onto the local column axis, max minus min, in calibrated units.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: This is the endpoint the hypothesis is about. It is not cell length along the cell's own principal axis - a cell that elongates sideways gains principal-axis length and no axial height.

definition: Mean extent in the two directions orthogonal to the bone axis.
computation: Mean of the extents along the two axes orthogonal to the local column axis.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: Averaging the two transverse directions rather than taking the larger one keeps a cell that flattens in one transverse direction from reading as narrowed.

definition: Axial height divided by transverse width.
computation: terminal_cell_axial_height_um / terminal_cell_transverse_width_um.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: The one number that separates axial remodelling from isotropic growth. An isotropically larger cell holds this constant; a swollen cell holds it constant or lowers it; the hypothesised phenotype raises it.

definition: Segmented volume.
computation: Voxel count times voxel volume, after segmentation.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: Present so that a height gain WITH a proportional volume gain can be told from a height gain at constant volume. Volume is never the endpoint; it is the control on the endpoint.

definition: Angle between the cell's own principal axis and the local bone axis.
computation: arccos of the dot product between the first PCA eigenvector of the voxel cloud and the local column axis.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: A cell can get taller in its own frame while tipping out of the column. That is disorganisation, not elongation, and only this endpoint sees it.

definition: Mean cosine between neighbouring cells' local column axes within a clone.
computation: Mean pairwise cosine over the k nearest neighbours in the same column.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: Preserved column alignment is a requirement of the hypothesis, not a bonus. This is the endpoint that fails first under cytochalasin D.

definition: Mean cosine between a cell's long axis and those of its k nearest neighbours.
computation: Mean over k=6 nearest neighbours of |cos| between first PCA eigenvectors.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: Local order, independent of whether the global column axis was estimated well. A column-level measure can look fine while neighbouring cells disagree.

definition: Ratio of end-to-end column length to summed inter-cell path length.
computation: |last cell centroid − first| / sum of consecutive centroid distances.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: A column that zig-zags delivers less axial length per cell than a straight one, and neither cell height nor cell count sees it.

definition: Median centre-to-centre distance between adjacent columns.
computation: Median nearest-neighbour distance between column axes in the transverse plane.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: Falling spacing with constant cell width means columns are being packed rather than cells narrowed; it is the tissue-level confound for the width endpoint.

definition: Number of columns with at least one EdU-positive proliferative cell.
computation: Columns containing >=1 EdU+ nucleus, per calibrated section area.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: Elongation is column output times per-cell contribution. A compound that makes cells taller while silencing columns has traded one term for the other.

definition: Number of terminal hypertrophic cells per active column.
computation: Terminal-classified cells divided by active columns.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: The per-column output term. Together with axial height it decomposes any length change into 'more cells' versus 'taller cells', which is the decomposition the hypothesis makes a claim about.

definition: Number of cells in a resolvable clonal column.
computation: Connected-component count along the reconstructed column path.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: Elongation is column output times per-cell axial contribution. Without this the two are not separable.

definition: Extracellular matrix-domain height attributable to each terminal cell.
computation: Axial distance between the septal midplanes above and below the cell, minus the cell's own axial height.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: Longitudinal growth is cell height PLUS the matrix each cell lays down. A compound that raises cell height while collapsing the matrix domain has moved nothing, and only this endpoint separates the two contributions.

definition: Length of the hypertrophic zone.
computation: Distance along the bone axis between the first and last hypertrophic cell in a column.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: Included ONLY as a confound: the brief says zone widening is not the target. A hit that moves this without moving the height-to-width ratio has done the thing the hypothesis rejects.

definition: Widest transverse dimension of the explant.
computation: Maximum caliper width perpendicular to the long axis.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: The appositional-growth confound. Cytochalasin D and jasplakinolide both raised length and this together; the gate has to be able to see it.

definition: Fraction of proliferative-zone nuclei EdU-positive.
computation: EdU+ nuclei / total nuclei in the proliferative zone.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: Preserved proliferation is a requirement. A compound that lengthens cells by arresting the cell cycle is not a candidate.

definition: Fraction of TUNEL-positive nuclei.
computation: TUNEL+ nuclei / total nuclei.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: Preserved survival is a requirement. A dying cell can look tall.

definition: Fraction of cells excluding a viability dye.
computation: Live / total, live-dead stain at endpoint.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: Distinguishes apoptosis from every other way an explant dies.

definition: ER-stress and oxidative-stress signal.
computation: CHOP/BiP immunoreactivity and a ROS reporter, normalised to vehicle.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: A cell under injury-level stress can enlarge. Without this endpoint that is indistinguishable from regulated hypertrophy.

definition: Collagen II immunoreactive area fraction.
computation: Positive area / proliferative-zone area.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: Resting and proliferative matrix. Loss here means the compound is damaging the tissue upstream of the zone being measured.

definition: Aggrecan immunoreactive area fraction.
computation: Positive area / growth-plate area.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: Proteoglycan loss softens the matrix and changes cell shape mechanically, which would read as a geometry effect.

definition: EXTRACELLULAR collagen X immunoreactive area fraction.
computation: Extracellular positive area / hypertrophic-zone area.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: Preserved matrix production is a requirement. Cells that get taller while making no matrix are not doing productive hypertrophy.

definition: Ratio of intracellular to extracellular collagen X signal.
computation: Mean intracellular collagen X intensity / mean extracellular.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: A secretory block retains collagen X inside the cell, so TOTAL collagen X looks preserved while none of it reaches the matrix. Without this ratio a secretory blocker passes the matrix gate.

definition: Deviation of the explant long axis from a straight line.
computation: Max perpendicular offset from the chord, divided by chord length.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: Asymmetric growth bends the bone. A bent explant also mismeasures on every axial endpoint, which is why this is checked before anything else.

definition: Length gained after compound removal.
computation: Explant length at the end of washout minus length at washout start.
why_this_and_not_the_obvious_one: The endpoint every earlier stage of this project was missing. A compound that borrows growth and gives it back scores here and nowhere else.
